title: Crown Shaving - Hair Grooming Spray
description:
This lightweight, life-saving spray is as versatile as it gets, and sans the noxious fumes of an actual hairspray:

  1. Use it as a pre-styling agent — just before blow drying — for added volume and extra hold.

  2. Work a little through dry hair and watch that pliable texture take form.

How To Use It: Spray this onto your hair when it’s towel-dried, ensuring it’s held no closer than six inches from your head, then blow dry those locks before styling them. For a subtler look, spray some onto dry hair then style it with your fingers (and don’t overthink it). Expect a solid, yet maleable hold that can be restyled throughout the day with nothing more than a little water.

Ingredients: Water/Aqua/Eau, Ethanol, VP/VA Copolymer, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Hydrolyzed Wheat Starch, Glycerin, Tasmannia Lanceolata Fruit/Leaf Extract, Propanediol, PVP, Panthenol, Butylene Glycol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Extract, Melia Azadirachta (Leaf) Extract, Fragrance/Parfum, Polysorbate 20.

How To Use It: Once you’ve shampooed and rinsed, massage this through your locks and onto your scalp, and make sure you get in there. Wait three to five minutes then rinse again.

title: Crown Shaving - Structure Styling Paste
description:
A pliable, flexible styling paste that adds good, all-day hold, a subtle, matte finish that looks natural, and some volume for thin (or thinning) hair. And if shine and reapplying product aren’t your thing, then look no further. Sulfate and paraben-free, too.

Tip: If you’ve got a longer cut, start from the root then work your way up so the product’s well distributed.

Ingredients: Aqua/Water/Eau, Lanolin Wax, Beeswax, PVP, PEG-8 Beeswax, Lanolin Alcohol, Sodium Polyacryloyldimethyl Taurate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Behenyl Alcohol, Propylene Glycol, PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Parfum/Fragrance, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Trideceth-10, Tridecyl Stearate, Neopentyl Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Phenoxyethanol, Triethylene Glycol.

title: Crown Shaving - Fortifying Shampoo
description:

title: Feast - Recipes and Stories from a Canadian Road Trip: A Cookbook
description:
Two friends. Five months. One car. Ten provinces. Three territories. Seven islands. Eight ferries. Two flights. One 48-hour train ride. And only one call to CAA. The result: over 100 incredible Canadian recipes from coast to coast and the Great White North.




In the midst of a camping trip in Squamish, British Columbia, Lindsay Anderson and Dana VanVeller decided that the summer of 2013 might be the right time for an adventure. And they knew what they wanted that adventure to be: a road trip across the entire country, with the purpose of writing about Canada's food, culture, and wealth of compelling characters and their stories.
     37,000 kilometres later, and toting a "Best Culinary Travel Blog" award from Saveur magazine, Lindsay and Dana have brought together stories, photographs and recipes from across Canada in Feast: Recipes and Stories from a Canadian Road Trip. The authors write about their experiences of trying whale blubber in Nunavut, tying a GoPro to a fishing line in Newfoundland to get a shot of the Atlantic Ocean's "cod highway," and much more.
     More than 80 contributors--including farmers, grandmothers, First Nations elders, and acclaimed chefs--have shared over 90 of their most beloved regional recipes, with Lindsay and Dana contributing some of their own favourites too. You'll find recipes for all courses from Barley Pancakes, Yukon Cinnamon Buns, and Bannock to Spot Prawn Ceviche, Bison Sausage Rolls, Haida Gwaii Halibut and Maritime Lobster Rolls; and also recipes for preserves, pickles and sauces, and a whole chapter devoted to drinks.
     Feast is a stunning representation of the diversity and complexity of Canada through its many favourite foods. The combination of Lindsay and Dana's capitivating journey with easy-to-follow recipes makes the book just as pleasurable to read as it is to cook from.

In this game-changing camping cookbook, food writer and outdoorsman Chris Nuttall-Smith introduces an ingenious prep-ahead approach that gets most (or even all) of the cooking done before a trip ever begins. Just like that, you’ll be dining on show stopping Sweet-Tangy Lemon Ribs or Sizzling Cumin Lamb Kebabs paired with Puff-and-Serve Chapati.

Plus, learn about the best-traveling cheeses, how to chill drinks when you don’t have ice, how to pick (and use) the right camp stove, and how to make great coffee outdoors! Cook It Wild proves that cooks and campers of every level can have the most spectacular campfire meals.

title: Mushrooms - How to Identify and Gather Wild Mushrooms and Other Fungi
description:
Learn all there is to know about the fascinating world of wild mushrooms and other fungi!

Throughout the centuries, people all over the world have been foraging wild mushrooms and fungi for food. It can also be an exciting and rewarding hobby, with hundreds of different species to discover! 

This beautifully illustrated guide contains everything you need to help you on your next foraging adventure. Here’s what you can expect:

   • Insightful information you need to identify over 450 species of fungi from all around the world
   • Clear photographs of each kind of mushroom and its cross-sections are accompanied by annotations and descriptions, along with scale illustrations and identification charts
   • Learn about the different anatomical sections and features of fungi, then categorize and identify your own foraging finds through extensive, but easy-to-use, visual ID guides
   • Key information on habitat, fruiting, and which types of mushrooms are poisonous and which are edible. 

This mushroom foraging book is packed with vital information that will help you identify the exact types of mushrooms you are looking for when you’re out foraging. You’ll learn how to identify the caps, stems and gills, which all have different physical characteristics like shape and texture, and color.

From the Neobulgaria pura and the Mitrula paludosa, discover newly-found fungi species and complex ones which can only be viewed microscopically. The detailed illustrations and identification charts will help you name the mushrooms you find or hope to search for. 

Mushrooms is the perfect book for fungi enthusiasts, amateurs, experts or anyone wanting to learn more about fungi.

From the Yukon’s Sour Toe Shot to a Prairie Caesar to New Brunswick’s Fiddlehead Martini, each beautifully crafted recipe—comprising updated classics, signature drinks from Canada’s top bartenders and the authors’ own creations—features quintessentially Canadian ingredients and cultural references, blending to create a libatious and entertaining journey from sea to shining sea.
Also featured are syrup and infusion recipes, tips and tricks, technique and equipment guides, as well as travel narratives and recommendations from the authors’ cross-country road trips.
Authors Victoria Walsh and Scott McCallum have dedicated countless hours, not to mention gas mileage, foraging, travelling and experimenting, in order to instill their own brand of northern spirit into the existing cocktail canon, and to add to the proud tradition of ensuring Canadian drinks, history and lore, in all their glory, are served at the global bar.

Learn the background of Canada's formation in 1867 when three British colonies united to create a partially independent state of four provinces. 

Read how Canada achieved full independence in 1931. Experience a modern country self-sufficient in fossil fuels, whose rivers supply hydroelectric power to the big cities of Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver. It's here that you'll meet most Canadians, with three-quarters of the population now living in such metropolitan areas. Within these cities, immigrants from all over the Earth have etched out their own communities, making Canadian society a modern mosaic of assimilated cultures.

Handcraft is part of human nature: we build, we create, we innovate. The 20+ projects in this book from an experienced art educator weave a story of human innovation and creativity, from the very beginnings of building shelters in the woods to tinkering with recycled materials. A centuries-old playing card system commonly used for divination, self-exploration, and to shed light on personal or universal issues, tarot is experiencing a surge in popularity. title: Weird Guy - Elephant 14 - Dirty Elephant
description:
The Elephant 14 ..aka Dirty Elephant is a 20oz super heavyweight Japanese selvedge denim that combines the bold, rugged weight of our iconic Elephant series with the distinct character of one of our most beloved core fabrics - Dirty Fade Selvedge. The warp yarns are rope-dyed in indigo, but start as naturally dusty brown cotton. As the denim fades with wear, layers of indigo chip away to reveal the earthy brown undertone beneath, giving this fabric its signature “dirty” fade. Finishing details include contrast stitching, a 5oz vegetable-tanned leather patch, a custom red/white/red selvedge ID, and silver metallic buttons and rivets.

True Guy is a straight leg fit with a medium rise along with extra room in the seat and thigh that falls straight from knee to hem.

title: Weird Guy - Natural Indigo Selvedge - Canadian Tuxedo N&F Collab
description:
An essential to the Canadian Tuxedo. 
Meet our collab Denim with Naked & Famous.

The Natural Indigo Selvedge is a 12.5oz indigo rope dyed Japanese selvedge denim, woven on vintage shuttle looms in a right hand twill construction. Natural indigo dye derived from fermenting the indigofera plant is used to create the mid blue color tone of these jeans. Other details include contrast stitching, full grain English tan leather patch, blue selvedge ID, dark copper buttons and rivets.

The Weird Guy is a regular tapered fit; medium rise, standard thigh and slight taper from the knee to hem

  • 100% Cotton
  • Made in Canada
  • Collaboration back leather patch
  • Collaboration 'Canadian Tuxedo' Pocket Flasher

Everything.

Our dermatologist-developed and tested fragrance-free shampoo concentrate is more than 50% moisturizers, for a soothing, gentle cleanse that even the most sensitive scalps will love. Simply activate this concentrated cream with the water already in your shower and watch it transform into a rich, creamy lather that doesn't strip or weigh down hair, leaving it soft, silky and super shiny.

This travel mini tin is perfectly portable (think vacation, gym, outdoor adventure) and perfect for taking our beloved Fragrance-Free Shampoo Concentrate for a test drive. Each 20ml (0.68oz) recyclable tin gives 10+ washes.

  • Dermatologist-developed and tested to be non-irritating and hypoallergenic
  • Strengthens and visibly repairs hair with patented, all-natural bond repair technology
  • Contains 30% glycerin for deep hydration, smoothing and shine - Contains 18% aloe vera to soothe dry scalp and reduce scalp inflammation 

Made in Canada

title: Work Shirt - Triple Twist Yarn Flannel - Blue/Beige
description:
The Triple Twist Yarn Flannel is a 7.75oz Japanese cotton fabric woven with a unique three-ply melange yarn. Each yarn is spun from multiple shades of cotton, creating a subtle variation in tone that gives the fabric its three-dimensional depth.

While its appearance is reminiscent of wool, the fabric is made from 100% cotton, offering a soft touch and breathable comfort with none of the itchiness associated with wool. The triple twist yarn construction not only adds visual complexity but also gives the cloth a slightly heavier drape and increased durability compared to standard single-ply cotton weaves.

The Work Shirt is a classic fit overshirt with a boxy silhouette, chest pockets and a pen pocket opening in the left pocket.

  • Japanese Fabric
  • 100% Cotton
  • Made in Canada

title: Weird Guy - Yatagarasu Selvedge
description:
The Yatagarasu Selvedge is a 15oz Japanese selvedge denim inspired by Yatagarasu, the mythical three-legged crow and revered Shinto God of guidance. This denim features a sulfur-dyed black warp that delivers a deep, rich tone from the outset. As the denim wears in, the contrasting white weft begins to emerge, creating dynamic, high-contrast fades unique to each wearer. Key details include tonal stitching, black pocket bags, pink selvedge ID, and black military spec copper buttons and rivets. The standout natural vegetable-tanned leather patch featuring metallic black foil artwork by renowned Canadian artist Jacqui Oakley, adds a powerful visual element to this mythologically-inspired piece.

The Weird Guy is a regular tapered fit; medium rise, standard thigh and slight taper from the knee to hem.

title: Strong Guy - Brown Fox Selvedge
description:
Introducing the Brown Fox Selvedge, a 13oz Japanese selvedge denim made entirely from organic FoxFibre® cotton—grown in California by cotton breeder and environmental pioneer Sally Fox. This denim contains no dyes or bleach. The brown color comes directly from the cotton plant itself.

Sally Fox began her work in the 1980s, selectively breeding heirloom brown cotton varieties with white Pima to create long-staple, naturally pigmented cotton that could be commercially spun. Her work eliminated the need for chemical dyes, significantly reducing the environmental impact of textile production. The FoxFibre® used in this denim is grown using regenerative organic farming methods, making it one of the most sustainable cotton sources available.

The denim is woven in Okayama, Japan, and spun in Osaka, using undyed natural warp yarns and naturally brown weft yarns. The result is a warm, earthy-toned fabric with subtle surface variation and a soft hand. Over time, the fabric darkens and develops a rich patina with wear and washing.

FoxFibre® Colorganic® is a registered trademark of Sally Fox.

  • 13oz Japanese Selvedge
  • 100% Organic FoxFibre® Cotton 
  • Button Fly
  • Made in Canada
  • Sku: 164133103

description:

The result is a rich, earthy undertone that subtly reveals itself as the denim fades, adding depth and warmth to the fabric’s character. This sustainable and innovative dyeing method not only reduces chemical use but also brings a distinctive hue and story to the denim. Finishing details include contrast stitching, a coffee-inspired milky brown/beige leather patch, silver metallic hardware, and a custom selvedge ID featuring a coffee/red/coffee color scheme - an homage to your favorite morning ritual. 

The Easy Guy is a high-rise tapered fit with a relaxed top block and a sharp taper from knee to hem.

title: Super Guy - High Noon Selvedge
description:
*Limited Edition*

The High Noon Selvedge is a 10oz lightweight Japanese Selvedge Denim, expertly woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama, Japan. Inspired by the rugged durability of 1900s era jeans, it captures the essence of that period. Just like denim from that era, the High Noon Selvedge is unsanforized to preserve authenticity. However, each pair has undergone a rinse wash to soften the fabric, minimize shrinkage, and simplify sizing. A defining feature of unsanforized denim is the characteristic leg twist, where the side seams twist along the fabric's bias. This adds a distinctive character to each pair, showcasing the old-world methods prior to the development of anti-skewing techniques designed to eliminate such twists. The denim sports a warm, mid-toned indigo hue, reminiscent of vintage pieces, and is highlighted with a classic red line selvedge ID. This lighter shade of indigo facilitates quicker fading, enabling you to achieve lighter, vintage-style fades much more rapidly.

Designed for immediate comfort, the High Noon Selvedge is lightweight and soft, requiring no break-in period. Proudly crafted in our Canadian factory, these jeans feature contrast stitching, button fly, a dark brown leather patch, and silver metallic hardware. 

The Super Guy is a skinny fit with a medium rise, a slim top block, and a taper from knee to hem.

    • 10oz Japanese Selvedge Denim
    • 100% Cotton
    • Button Fly
    • Made in Canada
    • SKU: 101127603

title: True Guy - Indigo Sashiko
description:
*Limited Edition*

Introducing the Indigo Sashiko, a 12.5oz indigo rope-dyed Japanese twill, woven with a raised running stitch pattern reminiscent of Judo uniforms. This fabric is highly textured, with the running stitches prominently raised above the base fabric. Inspired by the rigorous demands of Judo, which focuses on grabs and throws, the textured and grippy surface of this fabric provides an ideal base for indigo dye. As the raised portions of the stitches fade at slightly different rates than the base fabric, they create a beautifully nuanced fade pattern. This fabric was woven on a special jacquard loom, capable of creating complex patterns. Made from 100% cotton, this fabric offers a soft hand feel. Each pair is proudly crafted in our Canadian factory, featuring tonal stitching, a button fly, black non-reflective hardware, and a deep navy leather patch.

The True Guy is a straight leg fit with a regular rise along with extra room in the seat and thigh that falls straight from knee to hem.

  • Button Fly
  • Made in Canada

title: Denim Jacket - Revival Frankenstein Denim
description:
The Frankenstein Denim is a 14oz Japanese denim, intricately woven in an alternating twill pattern. True to its name, this denim is a mishmash of various construction details. The weave pattern alternates every 2 inches between left-hand twill and right-hand twill throughout the fabric. Since this denim does not adhere to a single twill direction, it cannot undergo anti-skewing, a traditional finishing process designed to eliminate the natural twist of the fabric. Consequently, the sections of left-hand and right-hand twill will twist along their bias over time, enhancing the fabric’s dynamic texture. Crafted with big slub yarns that alternate between thick and thin sections, this denim not only offers an incredible texture but also affects dye penetration during the rope dyeing process. This results in sections of the yarn fading at different rates, revealing a stunning spectrum of indigo hues as the denim ages. Made from 100% cotton, this denim offers a classic rigid raw denim feel. The jeans feature an upside-down leather patch—a distinctive hallmark found only in the Frankenstein Denim series. Proudly crafted in our Canadian factory, this jacket features contrast stitching, and silver metallic hardware. 

The Denim Jacket is a classic denim jacket cut to fit comfortably in the chest and arms with two chest flap pockets, two front slash pockets, and two large interior pockets.

  • 14oz Japanese Denim
  • 100% Cotton
  • Made in Canada
  • SKU: 164128164

title: True Guy - Love & Peace Selvedge
description:
